categories.main_business_segments: Cosmax BTI operates primarily as a holding company overseeing subsidiaries engaged mainly in the health functional food sector. Its key subsidiaries, Cosmax Bio and Cosmax NBT, focus on manufacturing and developing health supplements with diverse formulations including soft capsules, jellies, and probiotics. The company also manages intellectual property, licensing, and provides management and financial support services to its subsidiaries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced formulation technologies for health functional foods, including chewable plant-based soft capsules, jelly-type supplements, and probiotic production lines with enhanced survival rates. It emphasizes ODM and OBM models, integrating product planning, development, and manufacturing. R&D centers conduct safety, efficacy, and new material research, collaborating with universities and government institutes to develop proprietary functional ingredients approved by regulatory authorities.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Cosmax BTI serves B2B customers including distribution companies, pharmaceutical and food companies, network marketing firms, and global health supplement brands. Its products reach end consumers through large retailers, home shopping, online channels, and network marketing. The company targets domestic Korean markets and international markets such as China, the US, Australia, and Southeast Asia, focusing on health-conscious consumers seeking personalized and functional supplements.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in South Korea with manufacturing facilities in Icheon and Jecheon. It has established subsidiaries and production plants in the United States, Australia, China, and Singapore to support global supply chains and local market penetration. Overseas sales accounted for 65% of consolidated revenue in 2023, reflecting a strong international presence across North America, Asia-Pacific, and Southeast Asia.
categories.supply_chain_position: Cosmax BTI and its subsidiaries operate mainly in the midstream segment of the health functional food supply chain, focusing on product development, manufacturing (ODM/OEM), and formulation innovation. They also engage in upstream activities such as proprietary raw material development and regulatory approval. The company supports downstream distribution through partnerships but primarily supplies B2B clients rather than direct retail.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in new functional ingredients, personalized nutrition solutions, and novel dosage forms such as bars and easy-dose formats. It invests in AI-based platforms for ultra-personalized beauty and health solutions and pursues regulatory approvals for proprietary ingredients to differentiate products. Collaborations with academic and government research bodies underpin its innovation pipeline, with a focus on expanding global production capabilities and enhancing product efficacy and safety.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through the sale of health functional food products under ODM and OBM contracts to B2B customers. Additional income streams include licensing fees from brand and trademark usage, management service fees, and export trading commissions. The company also earns rental income and dividend income from subsidiaries, reflecting its holding company structure.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Cosmax BTI positions itself as a leading health functional food ODM/OBM provider in South Korea with a growing global footprint. It competes with other domestic and international supplement manufacturers by leveraging proprietary ingredient development, diverse formulation capabilities, and global production networks. Its competitive edge lies in technological innovation, regulatory expertise, and localized overseas operations, particularly in China, the US, and Australia.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2023, Cosmax BTI reported consolidated revenues of approximately KRW 628.6 billion with operating profits of KRW 20.2 billion and net income of KRW 2.5 billion. The company has shown steady revenue growth over recent years, with significant export expansion contributing to 65% of sales. Total assets stand at KRW 878.3 billion, and the company maintains a robust capital structure with equity totaling KRW 252.4 billion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Cosmax BTI offers differentiated value through its ability to develop and manufacture a wide range of innovative health functional food formulations, including unique chewable and jelly types. Its proprietary functional ingredients with regulatory approvals provide competitive advantages. The company’s global production network and AI-driven personalized health platforms enable tailored solutions, enhancing customer satisfaction and market responsiveness.
